scientific_question: Which physical predictor best explains the frequency and time-varying damping of the extracted non-QNM direct-wave component across the published SXS remnant-spin sweep?
claim_separation: a non-QNM residual is extractable under a specified filter
its instantaneous frequency and damping can be estimated under a specified model
the component is physically associated with Kerr horizon angular velocity or surface gravity
the component can be used to test Hawking's area law

primary_references.authors: Jun-Xi Shi, Zhen-Tao He, Tingyuan Jiang, Yu Tian, Dan-Dan Yuan, Hongbao Zhang

primary_references.title: How much of the black hole ringdown is sourced within the light ring?
primary_references.key_result: For the modeled plunging point-particle source, the maximum wave amplitude sourced within the prograde light ring is estimated at <=10% of the full trajectory contribution; for GW250114 the post-peak SNR from within-light-ring sourced waves is estimated <=1 under the paper's setup.
primary_references.caveat: Model-dependent source-region estimate, not a direct measurement of the horizon or a universal bound for all mergers.
